question: Rows storing a pitch count above 1 beside a length over 100 m per pitch: is the count a placeholder (too low for the route) or the count of the roped steps on a longer snow route?
method: 24 of the 58 modelled rows, picked by highest metres per pitch then by region; two Sonnet agents; at most about 6 searches per route; standard search first, extended once before recording nothing. Search snippets stood in where a site refused the fetch.
verdict: No row changed. The stored count is, in 15 of 17 cases, the published count for the route; it usually counts the roped steps while the length is the whole relief, so it is not a placeholder. The rule for stored data (a published figure for the route wins) leaves it as stored.

rows.name: Vision Quest Couloir
rows.why: 3 is the listing's count against 405 m of ice-and-snow couloir, which looks thin (its neighbour Black Ice is 8 pitches), but no second source counts it. Left.

rows.name: North Face Right Gully
rows.why: The listing counts the three ice steps; a comment pitches the bergschrund and second step and simuls between. Roped steps only. Left.

rows.name: South Gully/Ridge
rows.why: The stored count and length are the listing's own published figures, so the agreement shows the row copies its source, not that the count suits the Planner. It counts the roped steps of a longer snow route, not rope-length pitches. Left.

rows.name: Northwest Face
rows.why: Two sources agree: two 60 m roped pitches at the crux, the rest unroped. The count is roped pitches only. Left.

rows.name: Regular North Face
rows.why: The one real disagreement: the stored 4 is the listing's count, and four other sources give about 8 to 10 over a 400 to 550 m face. They count simul-climbed ropelengths and differ among themselves (8, 8, 9, 9 to 10+), so they give a range, not a value. The Planner prints 2.1 h of climbing at 4 and 4.2 h at 8, and the row has no walk data so its total already reads as a minimum (≥). No timed report was gathered to say which is closer, so a change cannot be shown to improve it. Left.

rows.name: Green Chasm
rows.why: The stored count and length are the listing's own published figures, so the agreement shows the row copies its source, not that the count suits the Planner. It counts the roped steps of a longer snow route, not rope-length pitches. Left.

rows.name: The Trap Dike
rows.why: The listing says most parties rope up for only a couple of pitches: the count is roped steps by its own words. Left.

rows.name: Northeast Couloir
rows.why: The listing's own text names more than two rope-lengths, so its count of 2 looks low, but 2 is the published figure and no second source counts it. Left.

rows.name: North Face Couloir
rows.why: The first-ascent report gives three or four roped pitches in a 1,300 m day; the listing gives none. The stored 3 sits inside that. Left.

rows.name: Bravo Glacier to Southeast Chimney
rows.why: 10 plausibly counts the summit tower only (about 260 to 270 m of mixed ground) while the length is the whole glacier route. Left.

rows.name: Bottomless Dogleg
rows.why: The stored count and length are the listing's own published figures, so the agreement shows the row copies its source, not that the count suits the Planner. It counts the roped steps of a longer snow route, not rope-length pitches. Left.

rows.name: Corridor saint-pierre Classic
rows.why: The listing's one 30 m ice pitch, then a snow slope soloed or simul-climbed: roped steps only. Left.

rows.name: Infinite Beauty
rows.why: No count or length published; the slab is about 3,000 vertical ft and climbed with hands in a few spots. Nothing to compare. Left.

rows.name: Timeless Treasure
rows.why: Same listing and grade string as Infinite Beauty; no count or length published. Left.

rows.name: Central Mowich Face
rows.why: The only count (about 14) is for the harder ice variation from one author; the standard line is largely soloed with one short WI2 pitch, so 5 is not clearly wrong. One source, a different line. Left.

rows.name: North Ridge
rows.why: No source describes this route; the peak's region may also be off. Nothing to compare. Left.

rows.name: North Couloir
rows.why: Named in one trip list (5.4 couloir) with no count or length. Nothing to compare. Left.

rows.name: Liberty Cap via Ptarmigan Ridge
rows.why: No total is published. One report counts a dozen or more simul-climbed ropelengths of snow and ice, one WI3 ropelength and a short rock step, so the stored 6 is a roped-pitch style count. Left.

rows.name: SW Couloir and Face
rows.why: The listing publishes no count; the page gives 3,300 ft (the stored length) and a grade. Nothing to compare. Left.
